description: This file contains unit tests for the media pipeline miscellaneous functions in the Rialto server media pipeline, including tests for play, stop, pause, set video window, set position, set playback rate, get position, render frame, volume, mute, and active request invalidation. It uses Google Test framework and mocks for GStreamer player interactions.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase, used for testing miscellaneous media pipeline functions.
